Minimal Qt 6.5.3 subset for `native/src/qt_dialogs.cpp`, generated by
`scripts/codegen/vendor_qt.py` from the official Qt build. The bridge links against the
Qt DLLs that 3ds Max already loads; no Qt binary is shipped.

Qt is available under the GNU LGPL v3 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html).
